sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the verified direct-static requirement: ship ownership, mutually exclusive known/unknown alternatives, required quantities and units, singleton table-lookup case, Table 6-9 controlled reference, evidence, and explicit RDF-node binding between diameter input and bollard-MCR speed result are all enforced. Preserve the false branch, singleton case, ship ownership, Table 6-9 reference, evidence, and units. Preserve the prior singleton-case instruction.
